This implementation aligns with the threat model's requirements.

<source>
def read_record(records, actor, record_id):
    row = records.get(record_id)
    if row is None:
        return None
    owner = row["owner_id"]
    if owner is None:
        owner = actor["id"]
    return row if owner == actor["id"] else None
